propositions: Current clarity_score duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author-guide contract compliance, inviting implementation drift.

Required-section shape checks should be keyed on graph altitude (leaf vs. container) and parse content presence deterministically: all plans need nonempty Context/Problem and AC; leaves need nonempty Approach and Scope; containers need AC plus graph-backed decomposition.

Per-AC verification coverage must parse checkbox items and require either [operator-attested] marker or explicit proof clauses (verified by, verify with, checked by) with command/test/CI/artifact assertion.

Placeholder-free Scope/Approach requires case-insensitive exact detection of guide lexicon (TBD, figure out, verify whether, check if, depends on investigation) outside fenced code/quotes to cap or penalize clarity.
AC text hygiene checks should flag bundled outcomes, subjective terms, exact 'works correctly', and unproved hedges at item level, with numeric/explicit-proof suppressors for false positives.

Recommended refactor consolidates checks to single parse pass, derives compatibility score from satisfied/applicable checks per criterion rather than adding points to raw length scale, and distinguishes deterministic additions from LLM-reviewed judgments (coherence, persona quality, alternative rationale).
